name: github-issue-intake
description: Resolve one or many GitHub issue numbers or URLs, fetch context via gh, and emit issue briefs. Use when starting issue-driven planning. Ask when ambiguous.

inputs.name: issue-references
inputs.description: One or more issue numbers or full GitHub issue URLs.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: owner/name for bare issue numbers. References that name a different repository are intake errors.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: issue-briefs
outputs.description: Canonical issue context objects for downstream planning agents.

outputs.name: intake-errors
outputs.description: Markdown list of references that failed intake; empty when none.
